responsibility: This file implements the AArch64 driver-side native CPU autodetection used for -march=native, -mcpu=native, and -mtune=native. It contains the driver-visible architecture, core, and extension tables derived from the AArch64 .def files, parses /proc/cpuinfo (or GCC_CPUINFO) to identify implementer, part, variant, big.LITTLE combinations, and Linux feature strings, and then synthesizes the appropriate option string including inferred architecture or CPU name plus enabled ISA extensions. Its responsibility is specifically host-side option selection in the compiler driver, not backend code generation.
